runners.comment: Below par latest but wind op since & ran well in competitive Becher at Aintree previously

runners.comment: Encouraging return from absence at Musselburgh recently and he's four from six here

runners.comment: Pulled up when last seen but on last winning mark; could get back on track following break
runners.name: Dare To Shout
runners.spotlight: Won off this mark on his reappearance at Carlisle (3m, good) in October and he's also effective on soft ground; not quite at his best here in November and pulled up at Newcastle later that month, but it's possible he'll get back on track following a 76-day break.

runners.comment: Twice placed in December; hampered when fifth of seven last time; might not be far away

runners.spotlight: Placed off this mark in two handicap chases in December (2m4f/2m3f, good to soft/soft); hampered four out when fifth of seven to Moon Phases at Newcastle (2m4f, good to soft) last time; might not be far away.

runners.comment: Won at Newcastle on second chase start and is in good hands to continue to progress
runners.name: Moon Phases
runners.spotlight: Went close on chase/handicap debut here (2m1f, soft) in November and won by a neck at Newcastle (2m4f, good to soft) last month; this unexposed 7yo is just 3lb higher today and in good hands to continue to progress.

runners.comment: He's run well in defeat on last two starts and may well be in the mix in first-time visor

runners.comment: Won on last month's chase debut at Ayr and could have plenty more to offer over fences
runners.name: Big Zouk
runners.spotlight: Point winner who improved upon his hurdle form to win by nearly 3l on last month's chase debut at Ayr (3m, heavy); this lightly raced 7yo could have plenty more to offer over fences and is firmly in calculations up 6lb.

runners.comment: Plenty of pointing experience; won at Sedgefield last month on second handicap start
runners.name: Slaney Opera
runners.spotlight: Former pointer who won maiden hunter chase here (2m7f, good) last April and was back on the scoresheet in a handicap at Sedgefield (3m2f, good to soft) last month on his second start for this yard; could play another leading role if coping with today's slower surface.

runners.comment: Unseated in three of his last four chases; could be a contender if minimising the blunders

runners.comment: Didn't convince with stamina when fourth over 3m2f at Sedgefield and has poor strike-rate
runners.name: Nights In Venice
runners.spotlight: Ran well when third at Musselburgh (2m4f, good to soft) in December but didn't convince with his stamina when fourth at Sedgefield (3m2f, good to soft) last time, and he's won just one of his 26 starts.

runners.comment: Remains a rules maiden after 20 attempts but some good form this season; holds e-w claims
runners.name: Wearelongterm

runners.spotlight: Point winner who twice went close over fences here (2m7f, good/good to soft) in the autumn and also ran well when third over hurdles at Musselburgh (3m, good to soft) last time; also effective on soft ground; remains a rules maiden after 20 attempts but holds each-way claims.

runners.comment: Out of form when last seen; hopes are pinned on subsequent wind op prompting a revival
runners.name: Don Brocco
runners.spotlight: Won at Carlisle (3m, soft) last February and he's on a competitive mark on last season's best form; however, he struggled in November on his last two starts; hopes are pinned on the subsequent wind op prompting a revival.

runners.comment: Below best towards end of last year and 8lb wrong at the weights today; others preferred

runners.spotlight: Won two in a row last March but 0-8 since and wasn't at his best towards end of last year; 8lb wrong at weights today; others preferred.

runners.comment: Beaten nearly a distance in a small field at Market Rasen (good) last June; opposable
runners.name: Captain Cognac

runners.comment: 66-1 when tailed off here last May and has since undergone wind surgery; no appeal
runners.name: Countryman Joe
runners.spotlight: 66-1 when tailed off here last May and has since undergone wind surgery; no appeal.

runners.comment: Irish point winner who beat all bar a Skelton-trained favourite in his first bumper
runners.name: Lion Rose Sivola

runners.comment: Some positives to take from his midfield finish at Newcastle (good to soft)
runners.name: Master Jack

runners.comment: Ran well for a 66-1 chance at Southwell, finishing 12l off the useful winner

runners.name: Prince Phil
runners.spotlight: Second foal out of a 2m5f hurdle/2m6f chase winner; lacks experience and headgear is fitted.

runners.comment: Half-brother to smart 1m7f-2m4f hurdle/chase winner Notlongtillmay
runners.name: Thelastmanfrompenr
runners.spotlight: Half-brother to the stable's smart 1m7f-2m4f hurdle/chase winner Notlongtillmay; dam unplaced in bumper, closely related to useful 2m-2m4f hurdle/chase winner Tiger O'Toole; could be interesting as trainer gets bumper winners.

runners.comment: Dam well related; stable has a smart bumper horse in A Likeable Rogue
runners.name: The Shanachie
runners.spotlight: 6,000euros foal; fourth foal; dam placed in a point, half-sister to winners Cole Harden (high-class 2m3f-3m1f hurdle) and Wade Harper (2m3f/2m4f hurdle); from the stable that houses last weekend's stylish Newbury bumper winner A Likeable Rogue.

runners.comment: Dam 2m hurdle winner and half-sister to 2m-3m hurdle/chase winner Shades of Midnight
runners.name: Ellistrin Jarla
runners.spotlight: Third foal out of a 2m hurdle winner and half-sister to useful 2m-3m hurdle/chase winner Shades of Midnight; trainer 3-33 in bumpers recent seasons.

runners.comment: Brought down about 4f out at Huntingdon so difficult to know how she would have fared
runners.name: Lady Bamburgh
runners.spotlight: Brought down about 4f out at Huntingdon so difficult to know how she would have fared; went off at 40-1.

runners.comment: Only a 4yo but nicely bred and trainer going at 11% in bumpers recent seasons
runners.name: Sea Tempest
runners.spotlight: 58,000euros 3yo; sixth foal; brother to point and useful 2m4f/2m7f chase winner Romeo Magico, half-brother to bumper/useful 2m-2m4f hurdle winner Ruaille Buaille; dam unraced sister to high-class 2m-2m7f hurdle/chase winner Hidden Cyclone; nicely bred and trainer going at 11% in bumpers recent seasons.

runners.comment: Beat useful rival at Ffos Las last month (front pair well clear); the one to beat

runners.owner: M W Lake & Exors Of The Late N W Lake

runners.comment: Well beaten on first two hurdling starts; can't be recommended

runners.comment: Close third on bumper debut last June but the form has not worked out well

runners.spotlight: Out of a useful and well-connected bumper/hurdle winner; close third in good-ground Bangor bumper last June but that form has not worked out well, and he managed only fourth of six in a similar event soon afterwards.

runners.comment: Won slow-ground Irish point by 24l in November; makes rules debut today

runners.spotlight: Out of a half-sister to high-class jumper Janidil; failed to complete his first two Irish points but won easily by 24l on yielding to soft ground in November and it will be interesting to see how he fares on rules debut.

runners.comment: Close second on heavy ground at Ffos Las last month; can improve if/when he settles better
runners.name: Emerald Breeze
runners.spotlight: About 28l behind Bossman Jack when third on seasonal/hurdle debut at Ffos Las (2m, soft) last month but bettered that performance when close second there (2m, heavy) a fortnight ago and can improve again if/when he learns to settle better.

runners.comment: Made quite promising hurdle debut last month and has each-way claims here
runners.name: Francky Blue
runners.spotlight: From a good jumping family and made quite promising hurdle debut when fourth of 12 at Leicester (1m7f, heavy) last month; each-way claims if able to build on that performance here.

runners.comment: Did not get competitive on hurdle debut; stable has much better chance with Bossman Jack
runners.name: Holeheartedly
runners.spotlight: Showed some promise on bumper debut in December but didn't get competitive on last month's hurdle debut at Lingfield (2m, soft); stable has much more obvious chance with Bossman Jack.

runners.comment: Placed in all three bumpers; has useful standard to reach on hurdle debut
runners.name: Im Wide Awake
runners.spotlight: Placed in all three bumpers, perhaps most notably when second of 15 on soft ground at Exeter in December; should have a future over jumps but has useful standard to reach on hurdle debut.

runners.name: Lancier Des Obeaux
runners.spotlight: Soundly beaten when a big-priced outsider for recent hurdle debut at Uttoxeter (2m, soft).

runners.spotlight: Runner-up on Irish point debut just over a year ago (soft ground) but raced too freely and was tailed off on rules debut at Fontwell (2m1f, good to soft; hooded) in October; back from another break today.

runners.comment: Safely held in Ffos Las bumper last spring and not seen since
runners.name: Passage Du Maure
runners.spotlight: Half-brother to three French Flat winners (7.5f-1m2f); safely held when eighth on bumper debut at Ffos Las (good to soft) last April and not seen since.

runners.comment: Irish point winner; fourth in a bumper on rules debut but struggled on hurdle debut
runners.name: Roi Du Roume
runners.spotlight: Irish point winner in November (yielding ground); quite promising rules debut when fourth in soft-ground Hereford bumper last month but hurdling debut at Ffos Las (2m, heavy) a fortnight ago was very disappointing.

runners.comment: Soundly beaten at 100-1 in two hurdles for new stable this winter
runners.name: Stone Cold
runners.spotlight: Showed some ability in Irish bumpers last year (good/good to yielding) but soundly beaten at 100-1 in two hurdles for new stable this winter.

runners.comment: Tailed off when 100-1 for debut at Ffos Las (2m4f, heavy) a fortnight ago
runners.name: Wings Of Arion
runners.spotlight: Tailed off when 100-1 for debut at Ffos Las (2m4f, heavy) a fortnight ago; drops in trip here.

runners.comment: Sister to stable's useful hurdle winner Listentoyourheart; overlooked by Harry Skelton
runners.name: I Heard A Rumour
runners.spotlight: Third foal; sister to stable's useful bumper/hurdle winner Listentoyourheart; dam bumper winner; overlooked by Harry Skelton today and entitled to benefit from this debut outing.

runners.comment: Tailed off when 300-1 for hurdle debut at Warwick (2m3f) three weeks ago
runners.name: Roberta Bishop
runners.spotlight: Tailed off when 300-1 for hurdle debut at Warwick (2m3f, good to soft) three weeks ago; drops back in trip here.

runners.comment: Easy winner at Doncaster and Lingfield in six-runner races over about 2m on good to soft
runners.name: Aqua Bleu

runners.name: Merci Mam

runners.comment: Showed some ability both starts but he looks clearly the stable second string
runners.name: Dreams Ka
runners.spotlight: Showed some ability on good to soft in defeats by about 12l at Doncaster and 18l at Warwick (hampered and stumbled on home turn) but he looks clearly the stable second string in this field.

runners.name: Maestro Du Mesnil
runners.spotlight: Out of a French hurdle/chase winner; 5-1, disputed lead for a long way when fourth of six at Hereford (2m, good) three months ago, about 9l behind the runner-up Aqua Bleu who was also making his debut; gelded since and is now tongue tied; should improve but others have more pressing claims.

runners.comment: Looked good prospect at Exeter; a question though whether it's of the longer-term variety

runners.comment: Didn't run badly when last of five at Windsor last month and enters calculations
runners.name: Gamesters Guy

runners.comment: 2-2 over hurdles; has made promising start to chasing career and is on a good mark
runners.name: Juby Ball
runners.spotlight: 2-2 over hurdles last season and has made a promising start to his chasing career this term; had to concede weight to higher-rated rival when runner-up in novice chase here (2m, soft) last month and remains on a good mark for this handicap return; good chance.

runners.comment: Positives can be drawn from both chase runs and this drop back in trip ought to suit
runners.name: Willmount
runners.spotlight: Did not fulfill his potential over hurdles for Nicky Henderson but, following a layoff, positives can be drawn from both chase runs for new stable this season; ran well until weakening into third here (2m7f, good to soft) in December and should benefit from this drop back in trip.

runners.comment: Getting high in the weights but she's in top form and another bold show seems likely

runners.name: Love Of Neymore
runners.spotlight: C&D winner on good to soft in December and has held her own in Class 2s since then, including a placed effort behind live Stayers' Hurdle contender Ma Shantou; likeable type and should have every chance.

runners.name: Jalisco Star
runners.spotlight: Couldn't get much going over fences but form figures of 122 since returned to hurdling at Class 4 level; up a grade here off a career-high mark, but this assured stayer has plenty in her favour otherwise.

runners.name: Princess Keri

runners.comment: Last year's winner; every chance should the change of headgear have a positive effect

runners.comment: Veteran who has twice made all at Fakenham this season; still well treated on old form

runners.comment: Ran well on seasonal debut but well held since and may prefer better ground than this
runners.name: Lilting Verse
runners.spotlight: Gave good account when second on seasonal debut at Ffos Las (3m1f, soft) in October and remains on a workable mark but her latest run was disappointing and she'd arguably appeal more on better ground than is forecast.

runners.name: No Tackle

runners.name: Eaton Anne

runners.comment: Made low-key stable debut over hurdles and gained his only Irish win on good ground
runners.name: Jasmin De Cotte
runners.spotlight: Signed off for Paul Nolan in Ireland with disappointing chase run in October and made low-key stable debut over hurdles in December; likely to come good for Dan Skelton at some stage but his only win was gained on good ground and others in this line-up have much less to prove.

runners.comment: C&D winner who has made the frame on all three hurdling starts this season; in the mix

runners.comment: On dangerous mark and suited by slow ground but it's a good while since he ran to form
runners.name: Hurricane Highway
runners.spotlight: Lurks on dangerous mark and is very well suited by slow ground but did not achieve a great deal when remote second in four-runner race at Hereford (2m5f, soft) last month and has not run to form since December 2024.

runners.comment: 0-6 over fences but went down fighting off much reduced mark at Ffos Las a fortnight ago
runners.name: Astronomic View
runners.spotlight: 0-6 over fences but went down fighting off reduced mark at Ffos Las (3m, heavy) a fortnight ago and has claims if in similar form again.

runners.comment: Shade disappointing last time but ran well before last-fence fall at Wetherby in November
runners.name: Carrigeen Castle

runners.comment: Has conditions to suit here but ran poorly last month, after a layoff
runners.name: Not Sure
runners.spotlight: Well handicapped on old form and will be suited by today's trip/ground but was pulled up at Ffos Las (3m, heavy) last month, after a layoff, and needs to have taken significant benefit from that outing.

runners.comment: In clear lead before penultimate-fence fall over C&D last month; up 6lb
runners.name: The Big Reveal

runners.comment: Didn't see out 3m last time; claims if judged on ready 2m3f Carlisle win in November
runners.name: Getaway Master

runners.comment: Out of sorts since returning from long absence this season; reverts to hurdling today
runners.name: Bolsover Bill
runners.spotlight: Dual 2m3f chase winner at start of 2024 (heavy/good to soft) but out of sorts since returning from long layoff this season; reverts to hurdling on tempting mark but needs a revival.

runners.comment: Showed only minor promise in his qualifying races but open to improvement in handicaps
runners.name: Harbour Light
runners.spotlight: Showed only minor promise in three maiden/novice hurdles (1m7f-2m) in December/January but moves up in trip for this handicap debut and has plenty of scope for improvement.

runners.comment: Good second here in November but far too inconsistent to rely upon
runners.name: Mumbles
runners.spotlight: Creditable second behind well-handicapped rival here (2m, soft) in November and will be fine over today's longer trip but has become far too inconsistent to rely upon, and needs first-time cheekpieces to help him rebound from a poor run over fences a fortnight ago.

runners.comment: Unexposed after only four hurdle runs but suffered heavy defeat on recent handicap debut
runners.name: Directly
runners.spotlight: Still unexposed after only four hurdle runs but suffered heavy defeat on last month's handicap debut at Lingfield (2m3f, soft) and needs to take a big step forward here.

runners.comment: Second of 16 over C&D in November; unlucky to come to grief on last two appearances
runners.name: Locked Down Lad
runners.spotlight: 0-10 over hurdles and not yet proven on soft/heavy ground but was very unlucky to come to grief on last two appearances and remains just 3lb higher than when second of 16 over C&D (good) in November.

runners.comment: Generally in good form this season, second to very progressive rival last month
runners.name: Inion Tiogair
runners.spotlight: Generally in good form this season and bumped into a very progressive rival when second at Lingfield (2m3f, soft) last month; ought to make her presence felt again here.

runners.comment: Showed no significant promise in three novice/maiden hurdles; handicap debut today
runners.name: Onehundredneighty
runners.spotlight: Showed no significant promise in three novice/maiden hurdles (2m-2m1f) towards end of last year, most recently when remote second in two-finisher contest on Boxing Day; improvement required on handicap debut.

runners.comment: Below form on both starts this season but won this race in 2025; considered
runners.name: Richardson
runners.spotlight: Slow-ground specialist who won this race in 2025 (soft ground) and followed up at Bangor (2m3f, heavy) 17 days later; returned from layoff with two lesser efforts this season but still considered; usually held up in rear.

runners.comment: 0-16 over hurdles but ran well when placed off today's mark at Warwick last month
runners.name: Churchman
runners.spotlight: 0-16 over hurdles but gave good account when placed off today's mark at Warwick (2m3f, good to soft) last month and has possibilities if new cheekpieces have any positive effect here; fine on soft ground; unraced on heavy.

runners.comment: In poor form for a good while but makes stable debut from a basement mark
runners.name: Mi Sueno
runners.spotlight: Ended last season in poor form for Paddy Butler and was also well beaten on consecutive outings in November but, having changed hands for 3,000gns last month, is worth in glance in the betting off basement mark in race his new owner-trainer sponsors.

16:55.race_name: Chepstow 9th August Centenary Raceday Handicap Hurdle

runners.comment: Ran okay before unseating in a chase here last month; still unexposed as a stayer
runners.name: The Grey Man
runners.spotlight: Ran fairly well before coming to grief at penultimate fence here (2m7f, soft) last month; remains very unexposed over this sort of trip and reverts to hurdling on a workable mark and with Sean Bowen booked.

runners.comment: Kept on to make the frame on both starts in blinkers last month (2m7f/2m); each-way claims
runners.name: Face dMusic
runners.spotlight: Very inconsistent over last year or so and tends to hit a flat spot in his races now but kept on to make the frame on both outings in blinkers last month (2m7f/2m) and seems versatile ground-wise; each-way claims.

runners.comment: Absent since spring 2024 and can only be watched on this stable debut
runners.name: Hunting Percival
runners.spotlight: Four-time hurdle winner (2m-3m2f, good/good to soft) but not since 2023; absent since well-held sixth at Plumpton (3m1f, good) for Syd Hosie in April 2024 and can only be watched on this stable debut.

runners.comment: Won without coming off the bridle at Huntingdon last week; 3lb well in under penalty
runners.name: Delta Blues Belle
runners.owner: Noel Fehily Racing Syndicate - Delta B
runners.spotlight: Very well suited by the hike up in trip at Huntingdon (3m1f, soft) last week, where she won without coming off the bridle; remains lightly raced after only five hurdle runs and is 3lb ahead of the handicapper under her 7lb penalty here; could be very hard to beat.

runners.comment: 0-13 over hurdles but was very respectable second when upped to 3m at Ffos Las last month
runners.name: Klic Boum
runners.spotlight: 0-13 over hurdles but was very respectable second when upped to 3m at Ffos Las (heavy) a fortnight ago and might still have a bigger run in him over this sort of trip if the ground is slightly better.

runners.comment: Managed only eighth of nine in first-time blinkers in December; now 0-6 over hurdles
runners.name: Milan Ac
runners.owner: Got There In The End Partnership
runners.spotlight: Managed only eighth of nine (albeit not beaten that far) in first-time blinkers (retained) at Taunton (3m, good) at end of last year and is now 0-6 over hurdles; should be okay on the slower ground here but needs to improve.

runners.comment: Showed some promise in latest qualifying run; up from 2m5f for this handicap debut
runners.name: Hairy Potter
runners.spotlight: Well beaten on first two hurdling starts but his keeping-on fifth in first-time cheekpieces at Ludlow (2m5f, good to soft) last month was more encouraging and further progress is possible in handicaps.

runners.comment: Absent since struggling twice last summer and now well into the veteran stage
runners.name: No Rematch
runners.spotlight: Absent since struggling twice on good ground last summer; might be seen to better effect on the slower surface here but it's hard to gauge how much ability he retains as a 12yo; usual tongue-tie/cheekpieces removed.

runners.comment: Won this race in 2025 and bagged a chase in December but has become very hard to predict
runners.name: Lightonthewing
runners.spotlight: Made all to cause 33-1 surprise in this race a year ago (soft ground) and bounced back to form again to win Wincanton chase (3m1f, soft) in December; current mark is workable but it's hard to predict whether he'll be in the right mood today.

runners.comment: Pretty good third on recent handicap debut (2m4f); up in trip again with cheekpieces added
runners.name: Walkinthepresent
runners.spotlight: Unexposed 6yo who made pretty good start to handicap career when clear third at Uttoxeter (2m4f, soft) last month; moves up in trip again and sports first-time cheekpieces here; could easily have more to offer.

13:20.race_name: £150,000 Prize Money On 4th May Handicap Hurdle

runners.comment: Again well backed at Wincanton last time and ran well to be third; 1lb higher
runners.name: Morning Mayhem
runners.spotlight: Again well backed at Wincanton last time (1m7f, soft), despite being 10lb higher than for the Uttoxeter win, and wasn't beaten far into third on tiring ground; up another 1lb but looks sure to be involved.

runners.comment: Ran okay in juvenile hurdles but hasn't kicked on following a wind operation
runners.name: Risk It All
runners.owner: Keith F J Loads & Harry Redknapp
runners.spotlight: Ran okay in juvenile hurdles but hasn't kicked on following a wind operation, beaten about 25l on either side of his well-held second in a small-field handicap at Fontwell (2m1f); handles soft ground but a bit to prove now.

runners.comment: Every chance on his second at Market Rasen; soft ground is the grey area
runners.name: Character Testing
runners.spotlight: Placed for previous stable; fell on debut for this one but gave the favourite a fright at Market Rasen (2m, good to soft; 3lb lower) and was clear of the third; unraced on soft ground so that's the concern; cheekpieces added.

runners.comment: At 16-1, he was struggling a long way out on stable debut at Uttoxeter (soft)
runners.name: LAllier
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced maiden who left his previous yard for 3,500gns; at 16-1, he was struggling a long way out on stable debut at Uttoxeter (soft).

runners.comment: 0-28; tailed off here in December and that's flanked by heavy defeats on the AW
runners.name: Alvesta
runners.spotlight: Has hinted at winning potential over hurdles but not when tailed off here in December and that's flanked by heavy defeats on the AW; this slow ground casts further doubts.

runners.comment: Won a bumper for Rae Guest but has no form claims on what she's achieved over hurdles
runners.name: Noble Miss
runners.spotlight: Won a bumper for Rae Guest but has no form claims on what she's achieved over hurdles, including two handicaps over C&D.

runners.comment: On a career-low mark and three of his runs this season have been very respectable
runners.name: Animal
runners.spotlight: Tailed off two runs back but the season had started okay given the company he was in and it was a solid enough run to be beaten 6l last time at Fontwell (3m2f, soft); same career-low mark here and firmly in the reckoning.

runners.comment: Won over 2m4f on heavy yesterday and carries a penalty; had a hard enough race
runners.name: One Last Glance
runners.owner: Fred Camis Ray Fielder & Mel Clarke
runners.spotlight: A bit up and down but won at Leicester yesterday (2m4f, heavy), albeit at the expense of just two other finishers; penalised accordingly and that must have taken something out of him; stays 3m on soft ground but this far is an unknown.

runners.comment: Stamina not proven over this far and she was a remote third at Hereford on Wednesday
runners.name: Seasmoke
runners.spotlight: Both wins (2m4f hurdle/3m chase) at Market Rasen but mostly consistent elsewhere and heavy ground perhaps not ideal when below her best the last twice, latterly finishing a remote third at Hereford on Wednesday; even if turned out quickly after those exertions, she's not a certain stayer over this far.

runners.comment: Beaten about 15l in his last two runs at Taunton and can look a hard ride at times
runners.name: Edgewell
runners.spotlight: Has won a hurdle race around here and did win over fences in Ireland; beaten about 15l in his last two runs at Taunton (3m2f/2m7f) and can look a hard ride at times.

runners.breeder: S A Richards & Mrs L Kemble
runners.comment: Third over 2m5f here on reappearance but he has a lot further to go this afternoon
runners.name: Brother Boris
runners.owner: Elb Bloodstock Ltd And R L Banks
runners.spotlight: 0-7 as a chaser; ran respectably over 2m5f here on reappearance (good to soft) but has a lot further to go this time and his two runs over nearly 3m were unconvincing; others might see this out stronger.

runners.comment: Inconsistent and unraced beyond 2m5f; stamina doubts are too glaring to ignore
runners.name: Miss Fedora
runners.spotlight: Last year's two wins at Plumpton were over 2m1f (soft/good) and she's unraced beyond 2m5f, over which she was behind Brother Boris here last month; stamina doubts are too glaring to ignore.

runners.comment: A remote third in this 12 months ago and nowhere near his best this campaign
runners.name: Spotty Dog
runners.spotlight: Thorough stayer but he was a remote third in this 12 months ago and nowhere near his best this campaign; an 11yo now and age seems to be catching up.

14:20.race_name: British EBF 'National Hunt' Novices' Hurdle (Qualifier) (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Joined this yard after winning a Limerick 2m3f maiden with authority in December
runners.name: No Cure
runners.spotlight: Wore a hood for his last two runs in Ireland and was going away at the finish in a 2m3f maiden at Limerick over Christmas (soft to heavy); looks promising.

runners.comment: Well held when penalised at Kempton but the winner is above average; bred for this far
runners.name: Swingin Safari
runners.spotlight: Good bumper form; fell in a strong Chepstow maiden when running well and then won in a big field at Wincanton (1m7f, soft); well held when penalised at Kempton (good) but the winner is well above average; bred for this far.

runners.comment: Bumper winner on good and comfortably won a 2m4f Plumpton maiden on good to soft
runners.name: The Boss Bear
runners.spotlight: Bumper winner on good and comfortably won a 2m4f Plumpton maiden on good to soft two months ago; seems on the right track and unexposed, so respected.

runners.comment: The hood made a difference when second to a talented opponent at Sandown
runners.name: Ionian
runners.spotlight: Well beaten in a point and on his hurdling debut, but the hood made a difference when second to a talented opponent at Sandown (2m, heavy); that form brings him right into it and this trip shouldn't be an issue.

runners.comment: Irish point winner who has run well in both his maiden hurdles; doesn't have a lot to find
runners.name: Jurys In
runners.spotlight: Irish point winner who has run well in both his maiden hurdles (2m4f, soft) and he'll improve again when settling a bit better; Topspeed and RPRs give him every chance.

runners.comment: Exposed as a poor handicapper and instantly opposable in a race like this; tries blinkers
runners.name: Porridge
runners.spotlight: Exposed as a poor handicapper and instantly opposable in a race of this nature; tries blinkers.

14:50.race_name: Terry Moyise Memorial Mares' Handicap Chase (Queen Boudicca Mares' Chase Series Qual') (GBB Race)

runners.comment: 3m1f perhaps too far last time and had previously made a good start over fences
runners.name: Kalista Love
runners.owner: Hot To Trot Jumping And Dahlbury
runners.spotlight: Only 2lb higher than when making a successful chase debut at Warwick (2m4f, good to soft; fine on soft) and ran to a similar level when beaten 4l at Cheltenham; 3m1f perhaps too far last time and she makes plenty of appeal.

runners.comment: Weighted to reverse last-time C&D placings with Belle Montrose; major player
runners.name: Moviddy
runners.owner: Noel Fehily Racing Syndicate & Miss J Wignall
runners.spotlight: Runner-up in this last year's when odds-on and went on to win at Wincanton off a 5lb higher mark; had this headgear combination back on when beaten 3l by Belle Montrose over C&D last month and has a 4lb pull on the winner; chance.

runners.comment: Struggled since returning from a break and was well behind two of these last time
runners.name: Jacks Touch
runners.spotlight: Three-time winner over regulation fences but has struggled since returning from a break and was well behind two of these last time; now has tongue-tie fitted.

runners.comment: Appreciated this longer trip when winning here a month ago despite being 6lb wrong
runners.name: Belle Montrose
runners.spotlight: Made it 2-3 here when coming from off the pace on good to soft a month ago and that was from 6lb out of the weights; that was a return to form from nowhere but it was her first go over this far under rules; 4lb higher.

15:25.race_name: William Bulwer Long Memorial Open Hunters' Chase

runners.comment: He was in better form when runner-up in this last year having won his previous race
runners.name: Frere dArmes
runners.spotlight: He was in better form when runner-up in this last year having won his previous race; very disappointing when pulled up back here just before Christmas and then unseated at Ludlow when 33-1; hard to trust right now.

runners.comment: Looked a shadow of his former self in three hunter chases last year
runners.name: Fix At All
runners.spotlight: Won hunter chases for Michael Scudamore and was a useful handicapper for Neil Mulholland afterwards; however, looked a shadow of his former self in three hunter chases last year.

runners.comment: Lost his way for Alan King and a beaten favourite in his two recent points
runners.name: Major Dundee
runners.spotlight: Last successful in the Midlands Grand National of 2023; lost his way for Alan King and a beaten favourite in his two recent points; tries blinkers.

runners.comment: Classy customer at his peak; just missed out at Hereford after a long absence
runners.name: Stattler
runners.owner: R Bartlett J Carthy & Mrs P Shanahan
runners.spotlight: Classy customer when with Willie Mullins, winning the 2022 National Hunt Chase at Cheltenham; looked sure to win after an absence at Hereford (2m5f, soft) only to be reeled in at the death; probably the one to beat.

runners.comment: It was a maiden hunter chase she won at Cartmel last May; looks outclassed here
runners.name: Hollywood Harmon
runners.spotlight: Three-time point winner; won a hunter chase at Cartmel last May when last seen but that was a maiden event and she looks outclassed in this company.

16:00.race_name: Racing TV Novices' Limited Handicap Hurdle

runners.comment: Has soon raised his game since upped in trip and could continue his progress
runners.name: Castanea Breeze
runners.spotlight: Won when upped in trip on handicap debut at Market Rasen (2m7f, good to soft) in December and 3l second of 16 at Wetherby (3m, soft) subsequently; could continue to progress.

runners.comment: Responded well for pressure to collect over C&D last month; just 2lb higher
runners.name: Apieceovfortune
runners.spotlight: Has won two of her four handicaps and responded well for pressure to collect over C&D last month (good to soft); off only 2lb higher her claims are crystal clear, provided she's okay on soft.

runners.comment: Up in trip but 6lb higher in future after his clear second at Market Rasen
runners.name: De Deli Counter
runners.spotlight: Unseated early when visored for his handicap debut and then finished a clear second at Market Rasen (2m4f, good to soft), having attempted to make all; 6lb higher in future so he'll have every chance if staying this longer trip.

runners.breeder: S C E A Le Haras DHaspel
runners.comment: Maiden who has made the frame in handicap, from 2m to 2m5f; stamina queries
runners.name: Path Of Stars
runners.spotlight: Maiden who has made the frame in handicaps, from 2m to 2m5f; whether she'll stay this far remains to be seen and especially on slow ground (best form on good or good to soft).

runners.breeder: E A R L Ecurie Des Mottes
runners.comment: Ground was heavy on stable debut; better expected with cheekpieces back on
runners.name: Junior Des Mottes
runners.spotlight: Best run over hurdles came on good ground when third at Ffos Las last May (3m; first-time cheekpieces); those aids return having been absent on stable debut when the ground was heavy; better expected.

16:35.race_name: Racing TV Open Maiden National Hunt Flat Race (Category 3 Elimination) (GBB Race)

runners.comment: £110,000 3yo and half-brother to five winners including useful Authorised Speed
runners.name: Beau Speed
runners.spotlight: £110,000 3yo and half-brother to five winners including Authorised Speed (useful bumper and 2m/2m3f hurdle) and Speedy Speed (French 1m4f/2m Flat and 2m hurdle); dam French 1m2f-12.5f winner; of obvious interest given his connections.

runners.comment: Point winner; it wasn't a strong bumper at Chepstow but showed promise in second
runners.name: Cooltobecareless
runners.spotlight: Won his Irish point on heavy ground and the second has won over hurdles; beaten favourite in what's proved a modest bumper at Chepstow in October but that was still an encouraging run with a view to the future (well related).

runners.comment: Encouraging third on heavy ground at Chepstow and entitled to build on thay
runners.name: Elusive Pb
runners.spotlight: Encouraging third on heavy ground at Chepstow, beaten 8l behind newcomer Trojan Tale who got stuck in the mud when well beaten in a good bumper at Newbury last weekend; this 5yo sported a hood on debut and is now tongue tied.

runners.comment: Flat bred and from a Flat geared yard; market support would heighten interest
runners.name: Inside Tracker
runners.spotlight: Seventh foal; half-brother to French winners Fast Tracker (7.5f-1m2f; RPR 113), My Scholar (1m2f; 107) and Opinion Writer (10.5f); dam unraced half-sister to Listed-placed 1m winner Leader Writer; Flat bred and from a Flat geared yard; market support would heighten interest.

runners.comment: Half-sister to six winners and stable has the odd bumper winner
runners.name: Golden Sanjida
runners.spotlight: Half-sister to six winners including Sanaija (French 1m4f Flat, RPR 101; 2m2f hurdle), National Wealth (1m6f; 88) and Swertia (French 1m4f/12.5f; 87); dam Group-placed 1m 2yo winner (109); stable has the odd bumper winner; needs a market check.

runners.comment: Always behind and beaten a long way at Huntingdon (good to soft) when a 28-1 chance
runners.name: Potters Honour
runners.spotlight: Always behind and beaten a long way at Huntingdon (good to soft) when a 28-1 chance.
